## Description {#details}

<p>This <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdnode">SDNode</a> is used for PSEUDO_PROBE values, which are the function guid and the index of the basic block being probed.</p>


<p>A pseudo probe serves as a place holder and will be removed at the end of compilation. It does not have any operand because we do not want the instruction selection to deal with any.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1959 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/selectiondagnodes-h">SelectionDAGNodes.h</a>.</p>
